lines: +  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
+.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
+.topbar { background: var(--header-bg); color: #f2f5f7; border-bottom: 4px solid var(--green); }
+  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap;
+  margin: 0; font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
+.mode-hint { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 8px 20px 18px; color: #9fb0bf; font-size: 13.5px; }
+.mode-toggle { display: flex; border: 1px solid #3c4f62; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; background: #101922; }
+  border: 0; background: transparent; color: #c4d2df; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;
+.mode-btn:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7fd6a0; outline-offset: 2px; }
+.main { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
+.panel { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 16px 18px; }
+.settings-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: end; }
+  padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; min-width: 140px; color: var(--ink);
+.seg { display: flex; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; overflow: hidden; }
+.seg-btn { border: 0; background: #fff; padding: 9px 16px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-soft); }
+.picker-box { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
+  flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--ink); background: #fff;
+  position: absolute; z-index: 30; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 6px);
+  margin: 0; padding: 6px; list-style: none; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px;
+  width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; text-align: left;
+  border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink);
+.selected-list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 14px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
+.selected-list li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 8px 5px 12px; background: #f5f8f9; }
+.chip-name { border: 0; background: transparent; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink); padding: 0; }
+.chip-remove { border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; padding: 0 2px; }
+.summary { background: #e9f6ee; border: 1px solid #a9d8bb; border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 14px 18px; }
+.summary-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
+.summary-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
+.badge { background: var(--green); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
+.summary-warn { margin: 0; background: var(--amber-bg); border: 1px solid var(--amber-line); color: var(--amber-ink); border-radius: 7px; padding: 10px 12px; font-weight: 600; }
+.summary-warn-inline { background: var(--amber-bg); border: 1px solid var(--amber-line); color: var(--amber-ink); border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; }
+.empty { background: var(--panel); border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 36px 20px; text-align: center; color: var(--ink-soft); }
